assets.prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather.
Asset type: final environmental painting for COSYWORLD's Greek ship-deck backdrop.
Input image 1 is the authoritative EDIT TARGET: the existing ship-deck-night.webp painting. Perform an identity-preserving time-of-day and weather edit, not a new interpretation.

Primary request: the EXACT SAME SHIP DECK and composition, now in rainy and misty DAYLIGHT. Preserve the entire original 1672 x 941 canvas, camera, viewpoint, perspective, framing, and precise geometry.
Change only illumination, sky, weather, water-surface response and the wetness of existing surfaces. This must switch cleanly with the existing night backdrop.

Lighting/weather: clearly daytime beneath a pale grey overcast sky, soft diffuse cool daylight, no sun disc, no stars, no moon, no sunset or pink horizon. Fine visible rain slants gently across the open air; low white-grey sea mist softens the same distant hills and shore, without relocating them. Keep distant coast silhouettes and horizon positions. Calm-to-lightly-rippled sea with delicate rain stippling, muted sea-blue and grey-green daylight colors. Keep the ship level in the same place. Wood is visibly rain-wet, with restrained grey sky reflections and small raindrop marks; no storm waves washing over the deck. The deck must remain fully readable for a game scene.

Strict composition invariants: keep the massive mast at left and its exact rope windings, bronze mast collar, foreground bronze fixture and beam; the same canvas sail cutting across the upper edge, its seams and edges; all rigging ropes and pulley blocks in exactly the same positions; left and right bulwarks with their existing carving, metal ornaments and rope ties; the tall curled prow at center-right; every deck plank, hatch, bolt, crossbeam and rope coil. Keep both lantern housings mounted in their original positions, now unlit daylight glass, with no orange flames or dramatic pools of lamplight. Preserve the warm natural walnut/ochre wood and aged bronze materials under the cooler daylight. Do not bleach the deck into monochrome.

Style: keep the reference's detailed painted environmental art, tactile brushwork, fine wood grain, period Greek ship details, natural atmosphere and subtle ink-like edge definition. Maintain its visual identity and polished rendering.

Output: exact 1672 x 941 opaque RGB-style painting; do not crop, enlarge, extend, zoom, reframe or change aspect ratio.
Avoid: people, creatures, text, captions, symbols added anywhere, extra ships, new objects, port buildings, sails/rigging redesigned, missing coils, altered mast/prow positions, open ocean replacing the same coast, night sky, stars, moon, sunrise/sunset, warm night lantern glow, lightning, giant waves, fog so thick that the deck disappears, borders, watermark or transparency.

previousRevision.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a finished landscape background painting for the CosyWorld card adventure game, wide 16:9, ideally 2048 by 1152 pixels.
Primary request: the view from ON BOARD the Greek ship that sails between Black pond and the Wine-Dark Harbor. The viewer is standing on its wooden deck, looking forward across the deck toward the curved prow and open water.
Ship design: a small ancient Greek wooden sailing vessel, dark weathered timber, graceful raised curling prow, carved bronze and wood trim, low gunwales, a single square ivory linen sail, natural rope rigging. Use this same modest vessel throughout; this is a close view from inside it.
Style: richly detailed hand-painted fantasy storybook setting, painterly natural forms, subtle brush texture, soft atmospheric depth, worn wood grain and aged bronze. Match a dark blue, starry reflected shore with mist over quiet water and a warm old-world Greek journey.
Composition: eye-level view from the rear part of the deck toward the bow; the open deck fills the lower half and spreads broadly across the image. Keep the middle third of the scene clear and spacious for character sprites. Place the mast and bundled ropes toward the left edge; the sail and rigging frame the upper edges, leaving the middle view open. Curving rails along the outer sides establish unmistakably that the viewer is aboard. Frame a gentle horizon beyond the prow. Keep the bottom quarter simple because dialogue and cards will be overlaid there. Make the centered crop still clearly read as a ship deck on a phone.
Lighting: a calm blue twilight crossing under the first stars; soft warm light from two small lanterns fixed to the ship's side rails, subtle reflections in the dark water. The distant horizon is soft and open, suitable for travel in either direction.
Deliver the environment painting only. The deck is empty and ready for the game's characters. No people, no animals, no text, no lettering, no logos, no interface, no border, no watermark. No harbor buildings, docks or destination-specific landmarks. No modern fittings, ship's wheel, cannons, pirate flags, or extra ships. Opaque background.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a redesigned environment background for Cosyworld's The Wine-Dark Harbor, a wide 16:9 painterly classical Greek coastal harbor for a narrative game. Input image is a reference for the world, warm stone architecture, coastal hills and painterly detail. Deliver the environment itself, edge-to-edge artwork. A broad weathered limestone quay occupies the lower 38 percent across the ENTIRE width, providing believable continuous standing space for four character overlays. Keep the middle foreground spacious with calm stone values. A stepped waterfront with small terracotta-roofed workshops, amphorae and olive trees on the left leads the eye to a distant hilltop acropolis. A sheltered harbor basin occupies middle-right, deep indigo water with muted wine-purple shadows and turquoise light near the stones. A curved stone breakwater frames the distant harbor mouth and blue hazy headlands. Golden late-afternoon sunlight, bright airy blue sky, rich warm earth tones, careful atmospheric depth, elegant hand-painted fantasy storybook realism matching the reference environment. Small coils of rope, stone mooring posts and cargo jars confined to edges. This is the OPEN BERTH variant: the harbor basin and berth contain only open water. Use exactly one wide landscape scene, with purely environmental artwork, free of lettering, interface panels, borders and human figures. Compose the vacant berth on the right so a later variant can add one classical wooden merchant vessel there. Eye-level perspective from the quay, believable dock scale and grounded environment.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the provided harbor environment into its SHIP AT BERTH variant. Preserve the exact camera, crop, dimensions, architecture, foreground stone paving, olive canopy, distant hills, clouds, light and color of the supplied image. Add one graceful classical Greek wooden merchant ship moored in the right half of the harbor basin, immediately behind the foreground quay. Weathered dark timber hull with a restrained wine-red painted band, curved bow, single mast, cream square sail furled tightly along the yard, simple credible rigging, amphora cargo glimpsed on deck. Show the hull at a slight three-quarter angle and add believable water reflections and mooring ropes attached to the existing right quay posts. Scale it as a modest seagoing vessel with its full hull fitting comfortably inside the right half of the scene. Its hull should sit in the water and its mast extend into the right sky. Keep the broad foreground stone stage fully available for character overlays. Preserve all land and dock geometry exactly; only the ship, its ropes and its local water reflections change. The image remains a single wide painterly game environment with purely environmental artwork.
